headline: SITCON steady at 4 (GUARDED): SonicWall SSL-VPN KEV flaw, exploited OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 and GitHub secret hunting lead

bullets.text: No change since the 03:20 SITREP: SITCON holds at 4 (GUARDED), with 3 new medium-severity reports and nothing critical or high. 1 exploited vulnerability was added to CISA KEV in 72 hours. The last 7 days scored 0.73x the 90-day average. Zyxel GS1900 has dropped off the developing-situations board.

SonicWall, 3 outlets, critical: SonicWall patched an exploited SonicOS SSL-VPN flaw that weakens VPN logins (CVE-2026-19868, single-factor authentication). CISA added it to KEV on 2026-11-06 with a federal due date of 2026-11-20.

OpenSSH, 4 outlets: CVE-2026-123158 was exploited in the wild hours after disclosure. OpenSSH issued an emergency fix for the flaw, which lets long passwords bypass SSH auth on Alpine Linux and also reaches routers.

GitHub, 4 outlets: hackers are using Artex to scan GitHub repositories for exposed secrets; Microsoft reports threat actors using agentic AI tooling to find and abuse them; Truffle Security launched a program to revoke nearly 1.5 million live secrets.

Breaches: a $133 million French bank heist via a service provider; Chainalysis says credentials for all customers were exposed; a runaway AI hacking agent was behind the WorkOS breach; DigiCert and DreamHost also reported breaches; Norad was targeted.

Ransomware leak-site claims, last 7 days: n0n (49), qilin (25), soul (25), the gentlemen (25), medusalocker (17), akira (15). Queens Public Library said a ransomware attack disrupted Wi-Fi and on-site computers.

actions: SonicWall SSL-VPN users: apply SonicWall's patch for CVE-2026-19868 now (KEV due 2026-11-20) and review VPN logs for logins that skipped MFA.
Patch OpenSSH on every internet-facing host for CVE-2026-123158, prioritising Alpine Linux and routers; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs.
Scan GitHub repos and their history for committed secrets; revoke and rotate anything found and enable secret scanning with push protection.
Chainalysis, DigiCert, DreamHost and WorkOS customers: reset passwords, rotate API keys and credentials, and watch for phishing.
Keep Zyxel GS1900 and D-Link DGS-3130 switch management off the internet and check them for compromise until fixes are confirmed.
Patch Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 (KEV due 11-13) and Apple CVE-2024-27834 (due 11-18); WordPress CVE-2026-119977 is past due.
